decisions.reason: A dedicated business unit for offshore oil, gas and renewables was publicly announced and staffed, and it fits the firm's stated diversification into offshore energy, so management will attribute any weak results to the temporary pandemic and oil-price downturn and persist with it.
Crew travel management is tied to the firm's core crewing business, and the slump in travel during COVID-19 looks temporary, so the firm will keep the service in expectation of recovery.

The online vessel information portal is part of the firm's announced digitalisation of ship management and costs little to keep running, so sunk development costs and public commitment favour keeping it.

The mobile performance app supports the visible digital strategy, and its disappointing uptake can still be blamed on early-stage adoption, so the firm will likely persist, perhaps by folding it into its broader digital platform.
